notes.note:
Extension users now see a more prominent message when an extension has an update pending that requires approval for new permissions or data collection consent.

  [1]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.mozilla.firefox_beta
Added three new search widget options. You can now set a search bar with image, private and voice search to easily search from your phones home screen!

Default homepage shortcuts other than Google now make room for the sites visited most often, more regions get their own set of default shortcuts, and there is no longer a limit on how many shortcuts can be added.
Fixed pages that request landscape orientation being saved as shrunken portrait pages when printing or saving to PDF.
